regressionFoundAndFixed.title: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY presence in .env broke 7 test files (9 tests) via real-provider routing into an exhausted account budget
regressionFoundAndFixed.discoveredDuring: Final untargeted `npx vitest run` for this Part B synthesis (not by any Part B auditor - production/env state, not lib/app/prisma code)
regressionFoundAndFixed.mechanism: The credential was persisted to .env earlier in this phase, per user authorization, specifically so auditor D (OPEN-4) could attempt real classifyConditionSuspicion() calls. With the key present, lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic/getStageCaller() selects the real VERCEL_AI_GATEWAY provider instead of the credential-less SyntheticExtractionProvider fallback for any test that does not explicitly override the caller. The account-level Gateway budget was already exhausted ($50.05/$50.00, confirmed by auditor D's own real-call attempt returning HTTP 402) before this run, so those real calls failed outright instead of degrading gracefully - causing 7 files / 9 tests to fail that were assumed-synthetic-fallback and had been green at the Part A freeze (250 files/2639 tests, 0 failures).
regressionFoundAndFixed.notARegressionInProductionCode: Confirmed by the production-freeze-proof above: zero lib/app/prisma changes exist between the Part A freeze and this check. This was purely a local, gitignored .env credential-state side effect, orthogonal to any of the 6 defect fixes.
regressionFoundAndFixed.resolution: Commented out (not deleted) AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY in .env with an explanatory note, since the budget exhaustion makes the key non-functional for any purpose until a human increases the account budget - leaving it live provided zero benefit and cost test-suite accuracy. Re-ran the full untargeted suite afterward: 255 files / 2686 tests, ALL PASSING, 0 failures - full reversion to the Part A-documented healthy baseline (file/test counts differ from Part A's 250/2639 only because Part B auditors added their own fresh test files, all of which pass).
regressionFoundAndFixed.humanActionNeeded: To ever complete OPEN-4's blocked real-model recertification, a human must increase the Vercel AI Gateway team budget above $50.00, then uncomment the key in .env before re-dispatching auditor D's 22 pre-authored fresh adversarial constructions (already committed, ready to run, in the OPEN-4 workstream).
